svg.text: Fig. S3 — Molecular vibration as an LC resonance: H₂, HD and D₂
masses as capacitors, the Heitler–London spring as an inductor (damped to Q = 200 for display); dashed: measured ω_e
Each peak sits 13.5 % below the measured line: the Heitler–London spring is too soft. The isotope ratios, set by the masses alone, agree to 0.07 %.
